Developer's note checked: Held for deals that are already on a non-default pipeline. Not covered: the deal cannot get onto a non-default pipeline in the first place.

Stage selection on a deal already on pipeline "1" works in the UI and API (3 stage clicks applied, pipeline kept) and an outside stage gets a clear 422. But a deal created on pipeline "1" (UI and API), or moved with Change pipeline, is stored on the default pipeline — 201/200 with the pipeline silently replaced, and a stage of the chosen pipeline is rejected ("not part of the 'Standard' pipeline"). Same on the Test layout. Only an import puts a deal on a non-default pipeline.

Checked:

  • Deal keeps the pipeline it was created on / moved to → Create and Change pipeline return 200/201 but the server stores the default pipeline — record shows Standard (Default) [FAIL]
  • Stage selection keeps the pipeline → Deal already on "1": qualification, negotiation, test-01 applied, pipeline unchanged [PASS]
  • Stages offered = deal's own pipeline → test-01 … identify_decision_makers shown and selectable [PASS]
  • Clear message when a stage is refused → 422: "Stage 'qualification' is not part of the 'Test-Pipeline copy' pipeline. Choose one of: …" [PASS]

Still failing:

  • Step 3: create on Test-Pipeline/"1" → expected deal on that pipeline; actual stored on Standard (Default) (POST 201, pipeline replaced).
  • Step 10: Change pipeline → PATCH 200 but pipeline unchanged (Standard).
